query: which shipment is the lost one, and how many days did it take?
notes: A row recoverable pruning is allowed to drop and that the task still needs. Every other row is a near-identical delivered record, so they are the cheapest candidates; at ratio 0.1 the needed row is in fact dropped. Retrieval is resolved before scoring, so a recoverable drop is not scored as loss -- an unresolvable one would be.
